apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Adds an optional Split touchpad control layout: drag anywhere on the left half to move and on the right half to look, including simultaneous two-finger input. Keeps virtual sticks as the default and adds sensitivity controls in Settings and the live stream controller panel. Includes the controller rumble strength and HUD shortcut changes from build 159. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner signing. The split-touchpad math and legacy-settings tests pass. The full simulator suite has one unrelated iPad Settings navigation test failure (missing UICollectionView) and one hardware-only skip.
